event: Disk-full interrupted md1us6 acquisition before complete-file validation
cause: Disk recovery on process exit was consistent with an unlinked previous XTC remaining open in an MDAnalysis reader; additional workspace temporary files consumed disk. Explicit reader close was added to prevent this source of retention.
action: Stopped downloader, retained atomic range checkpoint and partial file; root freed obsolete own-task temporary files; added explicit trajectory.close() before unlinking completed raw inputs
acceptance_gate: Resumed file must pass full published MD5 before extraction; partial or checkpoint state is not accepted as source integrity verification.
